title.en: The Electric 15 Order Has No Pressure Cell to Fill
title.zh: 电动15的订单没有压力格可填

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints Electric 15 at 15 kW, 8–10 m³/h, 15–20 m vertical, 60–80 m horizontal, aggregate 1–3 cm, pipe 100–125 mm, 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm and 450 kg. Pressure and hopper are not on the sheet.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把电动15印成 15 kW、8–10 m³/h、垂直 15–20 m、水平 60–80 m、骨料 1–3 cm、管径 100–125 mm、1900 × 900 × 1200 mm、450 kg。压力和料斗不在这张表上。

h1.en: Order Electric 15 from the Cells That Exist

directAnswer.en: An Electric 15 purchase from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai copies nine facts: 15 kW, 8–10 m³/h, vertical 15–20 m, horizontal 60–80 m, aggregate 1–3 cm, pipe 100–125 mm, 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm and 450 kg, plus the path. It does not copy a pressure, a hopper or a voltage, because those cells are absent. Electric 10 Series, also 15 kW, is a different order at 21 m³/h and 25 m horizontal. Send the Electric 15 path to [/en/contact/](/en/contact/) with your stone and your supply voltage as site facts.
directAnswer.zh: 向河北品锦机械（邢台）采购电动15，抄这些事实：15 kW、8–10 m³/h、垂直 15–20 m、水平 60–80 m、骨料 1–3 cm、管径 100–125 mm、1900 × 900 × 1200 mm、450 kg，以及路径。不要抄压力、料斗或电压，因为这些格子不存在。同样是 15 kW 的电动10系列是另一张订单：21 m³/h、水平 25 m。把电动15的路径连同你的石子和供电电压作为现场事实，发到 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/)。

body.en: Vertical is 15–20 m and horizontal is 60–80 m. Keep the ranges. They are not single guarantees and not Electric 20’s 120 m / 40 m.
body.zh: 垂直是 15–20 m，水平是 60–80 m。保留范围。它们不是单项保证，也不是电动20的 120 m / 40 m。

body.en: The frame is 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm. B500S-83D is lighter, at 280 kg, and only 5 m / 5 m. Do not substitute it when you need the Electric 15 ranges.
body.zh: 外形是 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm。B500S-83D 更轻，280 kg，而且只有 5 m / 5 m。当你需要电动15的范围时，不要用它替换。

body.en: 450 kg is mass. Ask Xingtai for the price.
body.zh: 450 kg 是质量。向邢台询价。

answer.en: It is not on the published specification list. Leave it off the order.
answer.zh: 已公布的规格列表上没有。订单上也不要写。
不是。是 100–125 mm。80 mm 是电动20。

answer.en: Both print 15 kW. The output and distance cells differ.
answer.zh: 两者都印 15 kW。输送量和距离格不同。
